experience.method_family: filtered/correspondence decomposition without independent discharge of every critical Hodge piece
experience.failure_mode: the route leaves a root-relevant graded/source piece whose only discharge assumption is the same unsolved cycle-map surjectivity in a renamed or localized form, so the decomposition produces no verified epistemic contraction
residual_signature: source and target can be decomposed exactly
an assembly theorem may be valid
at least one critical Hodge piece remains nonzero or uncontrolled
the only proposed source condition on that piece is an unproved surjectivity/representability statement equivalent in role to the original Hodge image problem
broken_assumptions: a mathematically exact decomposition is automatically a useful reduction of source-existence difficulty
scope_conditions: research-route evaluation for Hodge source-bearing filtrations/correspondences
SUPPORTED route diagnosis only; not a theorem that every decomposition has an open root-like piece
competing_diagnoses: a later geometric vanishing theorem may eliminate the critical Hodge target
a later explicit correspondence or moduli construction may prove the critical source map surjective
another filtration may strictly reduce the number or complexity of open critical pieces
experience.selected_diagnosis: decomposition alone is not the missing source theorem; progress requires independently discharging every root-relevant critical piece by source construction or Hodge-target vanishing
evidence_pointers: Donu Arapura, Hodge cycles and the Leray filtration, arXiv:2103.05038, especially Theorem 1.2, Corollary 1.4 and Remark 1.3
experience.falsifier_or_attempt: expand a proposed source-bearing decomposition and label each critical target piece KNOWN_SURJECTIVE, HODGE_TARGET_ZERO, or OPEN_ROOT_LIKE; test whether any OPEN_ROOT_LIKE piece remains whose only source hypothesis is unproved cycle-map surjectivity
experience.observed_result: the calibration distinguishes Arapura's genuinely source-bearing/vanishing reductions from an unpruned decomposition that merely relocates the original source-surjectivity obligation; the latter has no verified information gain
local_repair_attempts: seek a geometry-specific vanishing theorem for the critical Hodge piece
construct an explicit algebraic correspondence/universal kernel from a source family whose Hodge cycles are already controlled
change the filtration/fibration so the unresolved piece is reduced or eliminated

links.rationale: Both diagnose a valid surrogate/decomposition that does not preserve the root-critical coordinate through an extra bridge. The mathematical mechanisms differ: Hodge source surjectivity versus Yang-Mills continuum normalization, so only the bridge-audit warning transfers.
